upstream_expectation: an @annotation whose @id is an IRI is the error "invalid annotation" (json-ld-star PR 61, expand tst23)
our_expectation: the @id of an @annotation names the reifier and may be an IRI or a blank node; the document is valid and the IRI is the reifier of the annotated triple
rationale: RDF 1.2 Turtle allows any reifier on an annotation (s p o ~ <r> {| ... |}). Kellogg's own outline for PR 61 takes the reifier from the annotation's @id, and json-ld-star issue 49 agrees to allow @id in annotations to convey the reifier. tst23 keeps the rule of the 2021 RDF-star form. Owner, 2026-10-27, verbatim: "decisions - do something sensible and record the choice. Go for whatever is closer to RDF 1.2 direction."
